registration_note: Add 'savedView.spec.js' to the 'Logs-Core' shard run_files list in .github/workflows/playwright.yml (matrix entry at line ~138). Playwright auto-discovers *.spec.js under testDir, but the CI matrix run_files list is explicit.
rationale: No existing spec covers the saved-view-apply-on-build-tab flow. logsQueryBuilder.spec.js covers Build-tab open/chart auto-selection/query-mode but never saves+applies a view. The saved-view specs (monaco-query-prefill, logsqueries, logspage, region, RegressionSet, multiselect-stream) only exercise save/apply against the LOGS query editor, never the Build-tab builder-state restore. The diff adds a watch() to re-initialize BuildQueryPage when a saved view is applied while already on the Build tab — no existing test exercises either the onMounted restore path or the new watcher path. A new spec is required; the run-context spec_path matches the conventional Logs area folder and 'Logs-Core' shard.
